title: Brazilian Rice Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful rice tagine dish inspired by Brazilian cuisine, featuring tender noodles and velvety texture.
instructions: Heat the tagine in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the flat rice and cook until lightly toasted.
Add the quenched water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Add the noodles and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the brazilian and season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld.
